support_engineer: Hey team — customer reported a sudden ~30% token spike on their invoice vs our SDK estimates, happening since yesterday afternoon. They pasted a short convo and said SDK shows ~420 tokens but invoice shows 560. Can someone take a look? :eyes:

maria_gonzalez: Thanks. Do we have customer id / conversation id? Also which SDK version?

support_engineer: customer: acme-inc, convo_id: convo_2026_03_16_19. SDK: js-client v1.4.1. They attached a cURL repro and a cropped invoice screenshot.

alex_chu: Quick hypothesis — SDK local estimator ignores server-side injected system/tool metadata (KV cache prefill, toolchain traces) and also doesn't count opaque headers we add for routing. Had a ticket about this in Jan.

samir_khan: Can you paste the repro curl here? I'll run it with metering debug on my side.

maria_gonzalez: Repro (from customer):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-chat-large","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the quarterly metrics"}],"max_tokens":150}'
```

maria_gonzalez: SDK estimator output (their local run): 423 tokens total (prompt 270 / completion 153).

maria_gonzalez: From invoice screenshot: billed 563 tokens for same timeframe.

samir_khan: Ran the curl with metering header: `x-metering-debug: true`. Server metering response includes a breakdown header we emit. Here is the header value I saw: `metering-breakdown: prompt=312, completion=151, injected=100, opaque=0`

alex_chu: There — injected=100 looks like KV prefill + tooling metadata. SDK estimator (v1.4.1) lumps only visible user/system messages and generated completion, it does not model server-side KV/tool prefill.

ingrid_lee: FWIW some routing changes last week added a small audit envelope that gets attached for Dedicated/backplane customers — it can be ~50-120 tokens depending on model. We should confirm whether acme-inc is on Dedicated.

support_engineer: Acme is Hosted (standard). They are using a custom tool integration (calls out to a third-party agent) which might add tool prefill tokens on our side.

samir_khan: I captured the raw metering header JSON (trimmed):
```json
{"prompt":312,"completion":151,"injected":100,"session_prefill":58}
```

maria_gonzalez: So the invoice sums prompt+completion+injected = 563. SDK shows only prompt+completion = 423. That matches the delta.

support_engineer: Customer is surprised because their SDK estimate matched prior months. Did we change anything in metering recently?

alex_chu: We rolled out improved prefix caching in Feb that moves certain conversation prefixes server-side for efficiency. That reduces client latency but increases server-visible tokens (we prefill cached KV on the server). SDK estimator intentionally doesn't simulate server-side cache prefill because it's expensive to model. I flagged this in release notes but maybe it wasn't clear.

ingrid_lee: Action items: (1) Confirm exact tokens attributable to toolchain vs cache for this customer, (2) Ask billing to consider a one-off invoice adjustment if change was sudden and unexpected, (3) Add clarification to SDK estimator docs and a new header `x-client-visible-tokens` in future to help customers.

billing-bot: Billing ticket BT-8941 created and assigned to billing@redwood. Please add raw metering header output to the ticket.

support_engineer: @maria_gonzalez can you upload the metering header JSON and convo id to BT-8941? I'll send the customer a note explaining server-side prefill and offer to waive the delta for this invoice if they want.

maria_gonzalez: Done. Uploaded files + curl output. Draft message to customer ready for review.

samir_khan: I'll add a short diagnostic command they can run locally to confirm estimator vs server: add `-H "x-metering-debug: true"` to the curl and compare `metering-breakdown` header to SDK output.

alex_chu: Also adding a dev task to eng-ml to produce an opt-in estimator plugin that simulates server prefill for customers that want exact parity.

support_engineer: Great. Thanks all. Closing the thread for now — will reopen if billing wants more details. :thumbsup:
